description: Preload a model into VRAM for warm inference. Sends an empty chat request with keep_alive to keep the model loaded during the session.

keep_alive.description: Duration to keep the model loaded (optional, default: "-1" = permanent). Examples: "5m", "1h", "-1"

model.description: The model name to preload (must be already installed via pull_model)

name: preload_model
